en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Muhmmad Bin Imran Al Ijaly who said, 
‘I said to Abu Abdullah
asws, ‘Which thing was the place of the House (Kaaba) where was the water in the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [11:7] and His Throne was upon the water?’
Heasws said: ‘It was a white ‘Mahaat’, meaning a gem’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Sinan from Muhammad ibn ‘Imran al-‘Ijliy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,
’How was the site of the House when there was water? Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Glorious, has said, “His Throne was on the water. . . [11:9]
He (the Imam) replied, ‘It was Mahat, a white diamond.’”
